status: Author-proposed optimistic electricity-generation portfolios, not solved global optima or probabilistic forecasts
generation_boundary: Annual plant output before downstream delivery and storage losses. Hourly integration and losses must be reconciled regionally.

assumption_notes.portfolio: 40% solar, 20% land wind, 15% ocean in both cases. Hydro resource grows more slowly in the upper case; fission and geothermal take larger shares. Percentages are a transparent design choice to test, not a model-selected result.
assumption_notes.ocean: Offshore wind is wind energy located at sea. Strict marine energy supplies 300/400 TWh, or 0.5% of world generation, and is 3.33% of the proposed ocean total.
assumption_notes.capacity_factors: Illustrative fleet averages, not guaranteed plant performance; solar uses an AC basis. Dispatch, losses, degradation, outages, reserves, retirements and resource constraints require additional work.
assumption_notes.fusion: Zero required contribution; allow it to compete when a repeatable net-electric plant and full costs exist.
assumption_notes.storage: Storage shifts generation and consumes some of it; never added as a generation share.
assumption_notes.other: 600/800 TWh placeholder for regional sustainable bioenergy, solar thermal and other clean generation. No unassessed biomass expansion or unpriced fossil backup is silently assumed.
assumption_notes.cost: No global total-system cost has been established by this analysis. Regional costs from the separate hourly experiment do not price the entire global portfolio.
